evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 3.003 Torr before a sustained rise.
Pressure has risen monotonically to 3.227 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Temperature 749.8 °C, argon flow 99.4 sccm and heater power 43.6% remain stable; these do not explain the pressure trend.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; null O2 readings do not establish an oxygen-free atmosphere.
Growth requires an exhaust O2 sensor, so required atmosphere verification is unavailable.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning exhaust O2 measurement is needed to verify atmosphere; independent pressure verification, a seal leak test and exhaust-conductance checks are needed to distinguish causes of the pressure rise. Sample characterization is not yet available.
